title: A Letters for the Summer
author: Cyrus Nystrom
blurb: Ansel Eastwick, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
